description: Header file defining interfaces and enumerations for managing non-volatile backup RAM registers used in backup power scenarios within an embedded firmware project.

methods.name: backupRamLoad
methods.description: Loads data from backup-power RTC registers (non-volatile memory) based on the specified index.

methods.name: backupRamSave
methods.description: Stores data into backup-power RTC registers (non-volatile memory) at the specified index.
